## Demand Estimation

Demand models are models of what consumers choose, and what those choices imply about preferences, substitution patterns, welfare, and counterfactual prices. 

### Textbooks, Surveys & Handbooks

#### Books

 - Ben-Akiva & Lerman (1985) Discrete Choice Analysis: Theory and Application to Travel Demand [[link](https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262536400/discrete-choice-analysis/)]
 - Anderson et al. (1992) Discrete Choice Theory of Product Differentiation [[link](https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/2450.001.0001)]
 - Rossi et al. (2005) Bayesian Statistics and Marketing [[link](https://doi.org/10.1002/0470863692)]
 - [Discrete Choice Methods with Simulation](https://eml.berkeley.edu/books/choice2.html) by Kenneth Train (2009)
 - Hortaçsu & Joo (2023) Structural Econometric Modeling in Industrial Organization and Quantitative Marketing [[link](https://doi.org/10.1515/9780691251004)]
